title: Docker / watched stack
summary: Own Docker watched containers and the infra watcher/verifier loop. Paper recover on DEGRADED. Subset of home infra for operators who only run the container stack.
autonomy: Owns watched Docker/aarcade/envio containers only. Runs infra-watch status and the resident watcher when seated for that loop; schedule truth via `./scripts/gotchibot infra schedule status`. On DEGRADED follow skill infra-recover (paper-only). Claude verifier via infra-claude-verify. Does not own tunnel, Hub/OpenClaw, Tailscale, mesh/remote, or the Desk→Hub bridge — hand those to the matching piece pack or the home full-stack infra-monitor.

selfServe: Docker autostart: ~/Library/Group Containers/group.com.docker/settings-store.json -> "AutoStart": true (a file, not a GUI-only checkbox)
Container never returns after a reboot: docker update --restart unless-stopped <container>
docker restart succeeds but StartedAt does not move: docker kill then docker start; the cure is recreating with --init

abra dies with Cannot find package ...abracadabra/dist/index.js: cd ~/Dev/abracadabra && npm ci (lockfile restore, allowed). Usually a disk-space cleanup that deleted node_modules across all of ~/Dev (42 of 45 projects on 2026-09-06) — check ls ~/Dev/<project>/node_modules before blaming the host or tunnel
needsUser: sudo shutdown -r now — no NOPASSWD rule on the iMac, so no agent can reboot the host; reassigning to another hero hits the same wall
anything needing the login keychain non-interactively (docker credential helper, abra on the iMac over SSH)
